reply.text:
I'm sorry your shoulders are achy. That's one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I'd get it looked at before we decide what training makes sense around it.

What I can do is swap exercises in your program so you're not loading that area while you sort it out. Tell me which session the push-ups are in and what you'd like them replaced with, or say "swap push-ups" and I'll pick a replacement from the same pattern. Also let me know what to avoid if the doctor gives you specifics.
